price relative to 30-day volume-weighted average price (short-horizon cost basis, every U50 coin)

scope: DEV only. No criteria change. A DEV_PROMISING flag only leads to a report to the user.

segments.rebalance: every 14 days on the Monday grid; trade at open of day i; weights drift; real funding; ADR 0041 calibrated cost
segments.stablecoin_rows: only rows dated inside the segment read range; value used for day d is the Coin Metrics row dated d, and only days <= cut

trials.ST1_STABLE14_U50: S_d = sum of SplyCur over usdt, usdc, busd, dai that have a value on day d (usdt required); g = ln(S_cut / S_cut-14); if g > 0 hold the equal-weight U50 long (1/n each), else flat
trials.ST2_STABLE28_REL_U50: g28_d = ln(S_d / S_d-28); if g28_cut > median of g28 over all segment days up to cut (>= 60 values) hold the equal-weight U50 long, else flat
trials.VW1_VWAP30_U50: vwap = sum quote volume / sum base volume over cut-29..cut (>= 20 valid days); signal = ln(close_cut / vwap); long the LOWEST quintile, short the HIGHEST (wide_universe_dev.pick)

decision_rule: identical to ADR 0094/0096-0108; DSR N=3 and cumulative N, PBO CSCV-16 reported
after_result: Variants are new trials needing a new prereg. Trial count +3 regardless.
